articles.title_en: Eliminating Fares to Expand Opportunities: Experimental Evidence on the Impacts of Free Public Transportation on Economic and Social Disparities
articles.title_cn: 取消票价以扩大机会：免费公共交通对经济和社会差距影响的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a randomized controlled trial to study the employment effects of providing free public transportation to individuals with low incomes. A temporary subsidy that reduces the price of transit to zero has no significant effects on individuals’ paid hours worked or earnings. Using rich administrative data, we also explore a range of other outcomes. We find suggestive evidence that transit subsidies improve measures of financial and physical health. (JEL G51, J22, J31, L92, L98, R48)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项随机对照试验，以研究为低收入个体提供免费公共交通对就业的影响。一项将交通价格降至零的临时补贴对个体的有偿工作时间或收入没有显著影响。利用丰富的行政数据，我们还探讨了一系列其他结果。我们发现提示性证据表明，交通补贴改善了财务和身体健康指标。(JEL G51, J22, J31, L92, L98, R48)

articles.title_en: The Long-Run Effects of Peer Gender on Occupational Sorting and the Wage Gap
articles.title_cn: 同伴性别对职业选择与工资差距的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of the early gender environment on inequality in the labor market. To this end, we link primary school data to occupations and earnings. We find that women exposed to more girls at critical ages earn more later on: A 10 percent increase in the share of girls leads to a gender wage gap reduction of 2.7 percent. We explore mechanisms and find a strong selection of women into less gender-stereotypical educational tracks and occupations, leading to higher earnings. The gender environment at an early age, therefore, leads to persistent changes in career trajectories and earnings. (JEL I24, I26, J16, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了早期性别环境对劳动力市场不平等的影响。为此，我们将小学数据与职业和收入联系起来。我们发现，在关键年龄接触更多女孩的女性后来收入更高：女孩比例每增加10%，性别工资差距就会减少2.7%。我们探讨了机制，发现女性在较少性别刻板印象的教育轨道和职业中有着强烈的选择，从而带来更高的收入。因此，早期的性别环境会导致职业轨迹和收入的持久变化。(JEL I24, I26, J16, J24, J31)

articles.title_en: Communication Barriers and Infant Health: The Intergenerational Effect of Randomly Allocating Refugees across Language Regions
articles.title_cn: 沟通障碍与婴儿健康：跨语言地区随机分配难民的代际效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the intergenerational effect of communication barriers on child health at birth. We study refugees in Switzerland who come from French- or Italian-speaking countries and who, upon arrival, are randomly allocated to different cantons in which either German, French, or Italian is the dominant language. Children born to mothers who were exogenously allocated to a region whose dominant language matches their origin language are, on average, 72 grams (or 2.2 percent) heavier. Further analyses suggest that this effect is likely driven by information about health-related behavior and services. Coethnic networks, however, can partly compensate for communication barriers. (JEL I12, J13, J15, J16, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了沟通障碍对出生时儿童健康的代际效应。我们研究了来自法语或意大利语国家的难民，他们在抵达瑞士时被随机分配到以德语、法语或意大利语为主要语言的不同州。被外生分配到与其原籍语言相匹配的主导语言地区的母亲所生的孩子，平均重72克（或2.2%）。进一步分析表明，这种效应可能由关于健康相关行为和服务的资讯所驱动。然而，同族网络可以部分弥补沟通障碍。（JEL I12, J13, J15, J16, Z13）

articles.title_en: Transmitting Rights: Effective Cooperation, Inter-gender Contact, and Student Achievement
articles.title_cn: 传递权利：有效合作、跨性别接触与学生成绩
articles.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence of teacher-to-student transmission of gender attitudes in Pakistan. We randomly show teachers a pro-women’s rights visual narrative. Treated teachers increase their and students’ support for women’s rights, unbiasedness in gender implicit association tests (IATs), and willingness to petition parliament for greater gender equality. Students improve coordination and cooperation with the opposite gender. Effects are larger when teachers teach a gender-rights curriculum. Mathematics achievement increases for classrooms assigned to form mixed-gender study groups treated with an intense program (visual narrative and curriculum), while absent in same-sex study groups. Gender attitudes are transmissible and cooperation improves student outcomes. (JEL I21, I28, J16, K38, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了巴基斯坦教师向学生传递性别态度的实验证据。我们随机向教师展示一个支持女性权利的视觉叙事。受处理的教师及其学生对女性权利的支持、性别内隐联想测验（IATs）中的无偏见性以及向议会请愿以促进更大性别平等的意愿均有所增加。学生与异性之间的协调与合作得到改善。当教师教授性别权利课程时，效果更大。对于被分配到混合性别学习小组并接受强化项目（视觉叙事和课程）处理的班级，数学成绩有所提高，而在同性学习小组中则没有这种效果。性别态度是可传递的，合作改善了学生的学业成果。（JEL I21, I28, J16, K38, O15）

articles.title_en: Fiscal Rules and the Selection of Politicians: Theory and Evidence from Italy
articles.title_cn: 财政规则与政治家的选择：来自意大利的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: Fiscal rules, or constraints on the policymaking discretion of elected officials, are widely used to regulate fiscal policies. Using data on Italian municipalities, we employ a difference-in-discontinuity design to provide evidence of the negative effect of fiscal rules on mayoral candidates’ education. Municipalities in which fiscal rules meaningfully restrict the action space of politicians drive the effect. These results are consistent with a formal model of fiscal rules and political selection. We highlight that reducing discretion may affect the composition of the pool of players: It may alleviate pork barrel spending but also negatively affect the education of politicians. (JEL D72, E62, H62, H72)
articles.abstract_cn: 财政规则，即对当选官员政策制定自由裁量权的约束，被广泛用于规范财政政策。利用意大利市政数据，我们采用断点回归设计中的差异法，提供了财政规则对市长候选人教育水平负面影响的证据。财政规则实质性限制政治家行动空间的市政驱动了这一效应。这些结果与财政规则和政治选择的正式模型一致。我们强调，减少自由裁量权可能影响参与者群体的构成：它可能减少猪肉桶支出，但也可能对政治家的教育水平产生负面影响。(JEL D72, E62, H62, H72)

articles.title_en: Reconstruction-Era Education and Long-Run Black-White Inequality
articles.title_cn: 重建时期的教育与长期黑白不平等
articles.abstract_en: The Reconstruction era of American history (c. 1866–1877) saw widespread efforts to educate recently freed people—efforts that were partially curtailed after Reconstruction. This paper examines the impact of childhood exposure to educational opportunity during Reconstruction on later-life outcomes for recently freed people. Using data on the number of teachers in Black schools and a linked census sample, we find that Black children exposed to greater educational opportunity during Reconstruction had improved occupational standing as adults. Their sons also experienced gains, suggesting that Reconstruction-era educational efforts, had they persisted, would have impacted Black-White gaps into the twentieth century. (JEL I21, I26, J13, J15, N31)
articles.abstract_cn: 美国历史上的重建时期（约1866-1877年）见证了广泛的教育努力，旨在教育新获自由的人们——这些努力在重建后部分被削减。本文考察了重建时期童年时期接触教育机会对新获自由人们晚年生活结果的影响。利用黑人学校教师数量的数据和关联的人口普查样本，我们发现，在重建时期接触更多教育机会的黑人儿童成年后职业地位有所提高。他们的儿子也获得了收益，这表明重建时期的教育努力，如果得以持续，将会影响二十世纪的黑白差距。（JEL I21, I26, J13, J15, N31）

articles.title_cn: 传统黑人高校入学与长期结果
articles.abstract_en: Using data from nearly 1.2 million Black SAT takers, we find that students initially enrolling in a historically Black college and university (HBCU) are 14.6 percentage points more likely to earn a bachelor’s degree and, around age 30, have 5 percent higher household income and $12,000 more in student loan balances than those who do not enroll in an HBCU. We find that results are largely driven by an increased likelihood of completing a degree from relatively broad-access HBCUs in lieu of a two-year college or no college. (JEL G51, I23, I26, J15, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用近1.2万名黑人SAT考生的数据，我们发现，最初就读于传统黑人学院或大学（HBCU）的学生获得学士学位的可能性高出14.6个百分点，并且在约30岁时，其家庭收入比未就读HBCU的学生高5%，学生贷款余额多12,000美元。我们发现，这一结果主要由完成相对宽泛招生的HBCU学位而非两年制学院或未上大学的概率增加所驱动。（JEL G51, I23, I26, J15, J31）

articles.title_en: Routine-Biased Technological Change and Endogenous Skill Investments
articles.title_cn: 常规偏向型技术变革与内生技能投资
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how individuals alter their educational investments in response to routine-biased technology. We find that individuals growing up in robot-impacted areas are more likely to complete a bachelor’s degree and experience a relative increase in earnings. Changes in the skill premium and opportunity cost appear to drive these effects. To interpret these findings, we estimate a model of endogenous skill acquisition where changes in the demand and supply of skills shape the path of earnings. Counterfactual simulations suggest that the endogenous skill response cannot fully undo the adverse earnings effects of automation unless there are sufficiently generous educational subsidies. (JEL I26, J22, J23, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了个人如何响应常规偏向型技术而调整其教育投资。我们发现，在受机器人影响的地区长大的个人更有可能完成学士学位，并且收入相对增加。技能溢价和机会成本的变化似乎是驱动这些效应的因素。为了解释这些发现，我们估计了一个内生技能获取模型，其中技能需求与供给的变化塑造了收入的路径。反事实模拟表明，除非有足够慷慨的教育补贴，否则内生技能响应无法完全抵消自动化的不利收入效应。(JEL I26, J22, J23, J24, J31)

articles.title_en: Closing the Gender Gap in Patenting: Evidence from a Randomized Control Trial at the USPTO
articles.title_cn: 缩小专利领域的性别差距：来自美国专利商标局随机对照试验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Analyzing a randomized control trial at the United States Patent and Trademark Office that was designed to provide additional help to applicants who do not have legal representation, we find heterogeneous causal impacts across inventor gender, driven primarily by an increase in successful negotiations by women inventor teams via the use of examiner’s amendments. While both men and women applicants benefited, the probability of obtaining a patent was over 12 percentage points greater for women. Our results suggest that a portion of the gender gap in patenting could be eliminated through additional assistance during patent examination. (JEL J16, O31, O34, O38)
articles.abstract_cn: 分析美国专利商标局一项旨在为无法律代表的申请人提供额外帮助的随机对照试验，我们发现发明人性别之间存在异质性因果影响，这主要由女性发明人团队通过使用审查员修正案成功谈判的增加所驱动。虽然男性和女性申请人均受益，但女性获得专利的概率高出超过12个百分点。我们的结果表明，专利审查期间提供额外帮助可以消除部分专利领域的性别差距。（JEL J16, O31, O34, O38）

articles.title_en: International Transmission of Inequality through Trade
articles.title_cn: 贸易中的不平等国际传导
articles.abstract_en: I examine the international transmission of income inequality through trade. Using firm-level and aggregate data, I find that exporting to more unequal countries increases domestic inequality. I rationalize this finding by developing a model of international consumer targeting in which firms serve specific consumer segments in each market. Inequality in export markets shapes the distribution of firms’ profits and, therefore, the incomes of individuals linked to them, widening domestic inequality. The calibrated model suggests that international inequality transmission explains 4.4 percent and 4.8 percent of the observed levels of Gini coefficients and income shares of the top 1 percent, respectively. (JEL D22, D31, D63, F14, F63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了通过贸易实现的收入不平等的国际传导。利用企业层面和总体数据，我发现向更不平等的国家出口会增加国内不平等。我通过构建一个国际消费者目标定位模型来解释这一发现，在该模型中，企业服务于每个市场中的特定消费者细分群体。出口市场的不平等影响企业利润的分布，从而影响与之相关的个人收入，扩大了国内不平等。校准模型表明，国际不平等传导分别解释了观察到的基尼系数和顶层1%收入份额水平的4.4%和4.8%。(JEL D22, D31, D63, F14, F63)

articles.title_en: Does the “Boost for Mathematics” Boost Mathematics? A Large-Scale Evaluation of the “Lesson Study” Methodology on Student Performance
articles.title_cn: “数学提升”是否提升了数学？关于“课例研究”方法对学生表现的大规模评估
articles.abstract_en: Students in East Asian countries dominate international assessments. One possible explanation for their success is the use of “Lesson study” to enhance teaching practices; a collaborative process where teachers plan, observe, and analyze a lesson together. We evaluate a national teacher development program in Sweden—“Boost for Mathematics”—containing core elements of Lesson study. Exploiting the gradual rollout of the program across compulsory schools, we find that it improves teaching practices and boosts students’ mathematics performance. The positive effect on student performance persists also long after the intervention has ended. The program also passes a cost-benefit test. (JEL I21, I26, I28, J45)
articles.abstract_cn: 东亚国家的学生在国际评估中占据主导地位。其成功的一个可能解释是使用“课例研究”来改进教学实践；这是一个教师共同计划、观察和分析一节课的协作过程。我们评估了瑞典的一项全国性教师发展项目——“数学提升”——该项目包含课例研究的核心要素。利用该项目在义务教育学校中的逐步推广，我们发现它改善了教学实践并提升了学生的数学表现。对学生表现的积极影响在干预结束后也持续存在。该项目还通过了成本效益检验。(JEL I21, I26, I28, J45)

articles.title_en: Should College be “Free”? Evidence on Free College, Early Commitment, and Merit Aid from an Eight-Year Randomized Trial
articles.title_cn: 大学应该“免费”吗？来自一项为期八年的随机试验关于免费大学、早期承诺和择优资助的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence on the effects of college financial aid from an eight-year randomized trial offering ninth graders a $12,000 merit-based grant. The program was designed to be free of tuition/fees at community colleges and substantially lower the cost of four-year colleges. During high school, eligibility for the grant increased students’ expectations of college attendance and low-cost college preparation effort, but not higher-cost effort. The program may have increased graduation from two-year colleges but did not affect overall college entry, graduation, employment, incarceration, or teen pregnancy. Additional analysis helps explain these modest effects and variation in results across prior studies. (JEL I22, I23, I26, I28, J24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项为期八年的随机试验提供了关于大学财政援助效果的证据，该试验向九年级学生提供了价值12,000美元的择优资助。该项目旨在免除社区学院的学费/杂费，并大幅降低四年制大学的成本。在高中期间，获得资助的资格提高了学生对大学入学的期望和低成本大学准备努力，但并未提高高成本努力。该项目可能提高了两年制大学的毕业率，但并未影响整体大学入学、毕业、就业、监禁或青少年怀孕。进一步的分析有助于解释这些温和的效果以及先前研究中结果的差异。（JEL I22, I23, I26, I28, J24）

articles.title_en: Terrorism and Voting: The Rise of Right-Wing Populism in Germany
articles.title_cn: 恐怖主义与投票：德国右翼民粹主义的兴起
articles.abstract_en: We document that right-wing terrorism leads to significant increases in vote share for the right-wing, populist AfD (Alternative für Deutschland) party in Germany. To identify causal effects, we exploit quasi-random variation between successful and failed attacks across municipalities. Using the SOEP, a longitudinal panel of individuals, we find successful terror leads individuals to prefer the AfD and worry about migration. Political parties—the AfD in particular—adjust their messaging in election manifestos in response to terror. Overall, and in contrast to previous work, we find terrorism is consequential to the rise of right-wing populism in a Western, multiparty democratic system. (JEL D72, D74, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了右翼恐怖主义导致德国右翼民粹主义政党AfD（德国选择党）的得票率显著增加。为了识别因果效应，我们利用了各市镇成功与未遂攻击之间的准随机变异。使用SOEP（一项个体纵向面板数据），我们发现成功的恐怖袭击使个体倾向于支持AfD并对移民感到担忧。政党——尤其是AfD——会调整其选举宣言中的信息以回应恐怖主义。总体而言，与以往研究相反，我们发现恐怖主义对西方多党民主体系中右翼民粹主义的兴起具有重要影响。(JEL D72, D74, K42)

articles.title_en: Pandering in the Shadows: How Natural Disasters Affect Special Interest Politics
articles.title_cn: 阴影中的迎合：自然灾害如何影响特殊利益政治
articles.abstract_en: We exploit the quasi-random timing of natural disasters to study the connection between public attention to politics and legislators’ support for special interests. We show that when a disaster strikes, the news media reduce coverage of politics in general and of individual legislators in particular, and members of the House of Representatives become significantly more likely to adopt special interest donors’ positions. The evidence implies that politicians are more inclined to take actions benefiting special interests when the public is distracted. More broadly, our findings suggest that attention to politics improves electoral accountability even in an environment with stringent transparency requirements. (JEL D72, L82, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用自然灾害的准随机时机来研究公众对政治的注意力与立法者对特殊利益支持之间的联系。我们表明，当灾害发生时，新闻媒体减少了对政治总体以及个别立法者的报道，而众议院议员显著更可能采纳特殊利益捐赠者的立场。证据表明，当公众分心时，政治家更倾向于采取有利于特殊利益的行动。更广泛地说，我们的发现表明，即使在对透明度要求严格的环境中，对政治的注意力也能提高选举问责制。(JEL D72, L82, Q54)

articles.title_en: Healthy at Work? Evidence from a Social Experimental Evaluation of a Firm-Based Wellness Program
articles.title_cn: 工作中健康吗？基于企业健康计划的社会实验评估证据
articles.abstract_en: We employ a large social experiment combined with register-based data, allowing for up to 12-year follow-up to evaluate a long-lasting employer-sponsored health and well-being program. We show that employees at treated worksites receive fewer consultations from their primary care physician and purchase fewer prescription drugs. These effects persist up to seven years after randomization, though with some fade-out. We find no effects on overall hospitalizations in either the short or longer run, and the program was not successful in improving labor-related outcomes such as absence and turnover. Finally, we show some evidence of spillovers within the family. (JEL I18, I31, J28, J81, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项大型社会实验结合注册数据，允许长达12年的随访来评估一项长期由雇主赞助的健康与福祉计划。我们发现，在受处理的工场工作的员工，其初级保健医生的咨询次数减少，处方药购买量也减少。这些效应在随机化后持续长达七年，尽管有所消退。我们发现该计划在短期或长期内对总体住院率没有影响，并且该计划在改善缺勤和流动等劳动相关结果方面并未成功。最后，我们展示了家庭内部溢出效应的一些证据。(JEL I18, I31, J28, J81, M54)

articles.title_en: The Making of Civic Virtues:A School-Based Experiment in Three Countries
articles.title_cn: 公民美德的塑造：一项基于三国学校的实验
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that schools can foster the transmission of civic virtues by helping students to develop concrete, democratically chosen, collective projects. We draw on an RCT implemented in 200 middle schools in three countries. The program leads students to conduct citizenship projects in their communities under the supervision of teachers trained in the intervention. The intervention caused a decline in absenteeism and disciplinary sanctions at school, alongside improved academic achievement. It also led students to diversify their friendship network. The program has stronger effects when implemented by teachers who are initially more involved in the life of the school (JEL I21, I26, I28, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，学校可以通过帮助学生开展具体的、民主选择的集体项目来促进公民美德的传递。我们利用在三个国家的200所中学实施的一项随机对照试验（RCT）。该项目引导学生在接受过干预培训的教师监督下，在社区中开展公民项目。干预措施导致学校缺勤率和纪律处分减少，同时学业成绩提高。它还促使学生多元化其友谊网络。当由最初更积极参与学校生活的教师实施时，该项目的效果更强（JEL I21, I26, I28, Z13）。
